items.title: Automate live video failover with MediaConnect content quality events
items.summary: Learn how to automate live video failover with AWS Elemental MediaConnect content quality events. When frozen frames are detected on a router input, an Amazon EventBridge rule invokes an AWS Lambda function that fails over to the backup source, notifies the broadcaster through Amazon SNS, and stores a thumbnail and metadata in Amazon S3 as evidence.
items.creator: Robbie Hammond
